issues.description: Docs reference preview_fn API but PR adds zero tests for any of the examples.
issues.detail: The PR checklist explicitly admits 'Added tests to cover my changes' is unchecked. Documentation that shows seven preview types, closures, meta-config dicts, and node.preview() calls is itself an API contract. If none of these snippets are exercised by a doctest or example test, the docs will rot the first time preview_contract changes. Add at least smoke tests that import and instantiate each preview type shown.

issues.description: Basic usage example uses next() on pipeline.nodes which is brittle and probably wrong.
issues.detail: `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is a clever way to write `pipeline.nodes[0]`, and it teaches the reader nothing except a bad habit. If pipeline.nodes is ordered, say so and index it. If it isn't, this example is a bug waiting to happen when someone copies it into a multi-node pipeline. Pick one and write the obvious code.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return.
issues.detail: The function returns ImagePreview, then has a commented-out 'or a data URI' block below the return. That is not how you show two alternatives — it reads like dead code. Either split into two functions or use an if/else with a parameter. Copy-pasting this into a real codebase produces a linter warning on day one.

issues.description: Experimental warning is buried and lacks a version or removal policy.
issues.detail: A single admonition at the top says 'may change or be removed' and links to experimental.md. Fine, but the rest of the page documents the API as if stable, including specific meta keys like 'language' and Mermaid config schemas. Add a 'Stability' line to each subsection or at least mark the meta-key contracts as provisional, so readers don't pin code to them.

issues.description: CustomPreview example uses ellipsis literals which are not valid runnable code.
issues.detail: `'nodes': [...]` and `'edges': [...]` will execute in Python (Ellipsis is a real object) but nobody who copies this gets a working preview. Show one minimal real node and edge, or label the snippet clearly as pseudocode. Docs examples should compile and do something visible.

issues.description: Adding lowercase 'polars' to ignore.txt alongside existing 'Polars' is a style-rules workaround, not a fix.
issues.detail: The Vale ignore list already has 'Polars'. Adding 'polars' suggests the prose lowercased a proper noun somewhere. Either the prose should use the canonical capitalization, or the Vale rule should be case-insensitive. Bolting a second entry on for one doc is the kind of drift that makes the linting config meaningless six months from now.

review.summary: Docs-only PR introducing the experimental preview_fn API to users. The writing is competent and the type coverage is reasonable, but the examples are sloppy in ways that will bite anyone who copies them: dead code after returns, `next()` over `pipeline.nodes` instead of indexing, ellipsis placeholders pretending to be data, and zero executable verification that any snippet actually works against the current preview_contract module. The experimental warning is too quiet given how specific the meta-key contracts are. Fix the broken examples, add a doctest or smoke test per preview type, and tighten the stability framing. NEEDS-WORK.
